requirement.description: {model_monica} asked for automated acceptance criteria. The model team would accept manual acceptance criteria if the review cycle is shortened to one day.
requirement.reading: The model team would accept manual acceptance criteria if the review cycle is shortened to one day.

speaker.name: Model Monica
speaker.role: Specializes in designing, optimizing, and training machine learning models. Conducts data exploration and iterates on models to maximize predictive performance. Collaborates on model deployment, versioning, and performance monitoring.

output.objection: You are treating my request for automated acceptance criteria as a simple technical preference, but it is actually a demand for a faster review cycle. If you do not shorten that manual review to one day, I will not build the automation you are asking for.
output.correction: You misread my position as a preference for tooling, when I am explicitly offering a trade off. I am willing to accept manual criteria only if you commit to a one day review window, so stop filing this under model deployment and start filing it under process speed.
